description: T1 item 1, Digital partition of sky130-lvds-tx: the serializer RTL, the synthesis request that derives the gate-level netlist from it, and the committed netlist, whose freshness is a re-synthesis compared byte-for-byte. Covers the standard-cell partition only (up to the 8:1 to 2:1 reduction, spec S2); the analog partition's sources are cited separately.
